latest.title: The hyperbolic class and vanishing laws in a TMF-valued four-manifold invariant
latest.abstract: Under explicit hypotheses on the spectral Looijenga construction, we compute the hyperbolic-plane value of the zero-section invariant of Gukov, Krushkal, Meier, and Pei in periodic topological modular forms. The value is the Hopf element eta, and adjoining a hyperbolic plane acts by multiplication by this element. Earlier work obtains the hyperbolic value under an additional cobordism-duality assumption; here we derive it directly from the Looijenga restriction maps without that assumption. Together with annihilation and vanishing results for definite lattices, this gives a complete value formula on smooth closed simply connected spin four-manifolds. In particular, nonzero signature forces the invariant to vanish, so both orientations of a K3 surface have value zero.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 在谱 Looijenga 构造的明确假设下，计算 TMF 四维不变量的双曲平面值及消失规律。
latest.breakthrough: 去掉此前额外对偶假设，并给出单连通 spin 四维流形上的值公式。
latest.limitations: 基础构造仍有显式前提；K3 值为零不代表所有 TMF 型不变量均消失。 当前为摘要级分析，技术细节与结论须回查原文。
